info.name: Answer question based on Knowledge Articles and other Documents

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Identifier for the tenant/client whose documents will be used for answering the question

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Unique identifier for the chat session in which the question was asked

params.name: documentType
params.description: Type of document to be used for search

params.name: filter
params.description: Key-Value pairs to be used as filters. All filters will be treated as AND. Ex. ?filter[filter_1]=val_1,val_2&filter[filter_2]=val_3,val_4.

params.name: numDocuments
params.description: Number of Documents to use as context when generating an Answer (min 1, max 10, default 3)

params.name: userType
params.description: Type of user making the request

params.name: userName
params.description: Name of user making the request
